title: Unit Rental and Identity Fraud Endorsements: CondoGuard Tier Availability and Premiums
content:
Two endorsements of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy are governed tier by tier: the unit-owners rental endorsement, which insures a unit rented to others, and the identity fraud expense endorsement.

## Unit-owners rental endorsement

| Tier | Unit rented to others may be insured with the rental endorsement | Annual premium of the rental endorsement (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential | no | 0.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced | yes | 86.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential | yes | 86.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced | yes | 76.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier | yes | 71.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature | yes | 64.00 |

## Identity fraud expense

An included limit of 0 means the coverage is not included in the package; the annual premium shown is the premium of the identity fraud endorsement where it is not included.

| Tier | Identity fraud expense limit included (USD) | Annual premium of the identity fraud endorsement (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential | 0 | 25.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced | 0 | 25.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential | 0 | 22.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced | 25000 | 0.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier | 25000 | 0.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature | 50000 | 0.00 |

## Notes on the schedules

- CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential is the one tier on which a unit rented to others may not be insured with the rental endorsement; its rental premium entry of 0.00 therefore never prices an endorsement.
- The three tiers with an included identity fraud limit (25000, 25000 and 50000 USD) show an endorsement premium of 0.00; the three tiers without it show 25.00, 25.00 and 22.00 USD.
